The standard browser-bookmarks HTML format is the right choice. Skipping links that are already saved—using the same near-duplicate rules—and reporting how many were skipped is the right default.

It’s acceptable for this interchange format to carry only titles, tags, and original dates. A separate full backup including notes, read/archive state, settings, collections, and saved copies would be useful eventually, but it can remain outside this build. Block F is settled.
